scope: Synthetic-only verification of a complete latent-branch cache and analytic gradients for the frozen finite-residual conditional law. No new real-data readout or fitting.
basis: All original9 selected states passed fixed-zero local support/normalization. Exact first enumeration remains expensive:6864 full-forward calls,54.74min panel. Theta changes branch weights while residual nodes, physical endpoints and prefix legality masks stay fixed for a given latent branch.

fixed.law: The current cap4 finite-node conditional law, canonical features, background intervention, priors, physics and sigma1 observation kernel remain unchanged.
parameter_probes: One deterministic nonzero point: theta[b,j]=0.1*(-1)^(b+j)/(j+1), using the existing fixed block order b=0..4 and canonical feature index j=0..p-1.
fixed.real_panel: Preserve completed evaluation_summary.json and all9 states; do not rerun them to add a cache.
fixed.gradient_directions: Five block-only directions: entries (-1)^j/(j+1) in that block, normalized to unit L2. One mixed nonbias direction: entries (-1)^(b+j)/(j+1) for j>=1 across all blocks and0 for each bias, normalized to unit L2. Freeze these6 directions before evaluating.

cache: For each full current-intent configuration, retain the exact canonical feature vectors actually used at each stochastic decision, for every local random actor, with shared table indices.
Retain current and receiving intent IDs/prior factors, residual-node choices, permission bits and applicability. Include all local actors, not just the focal actor.
Retain sequential LC order, prefix-specific allowed masks, chosen classes and the exact feature-table references consumed at each decision.

Retain focal physical outcomes required by the existing observation kernel: survival/END, velocity, start, entry and LC class. Share prefixes and immutable feature tables; no duplicated full background frame per leaf.

likelihood_and_gradient.numerator: N_h(theta)=sum_eta w_eta(theta)*c_eta,h(y). Observation factors c use exactly the frozen kernel/reference measure.
likelihood_and_gradient.denominator: For motion/start/LC use D_h(theta)=P_theta(survive); entry uses1. Keep the denominator derivative.
likelihood_and_gradient.score: grad log q_h = E_eta|y,h[grad log w_eta] - E_eta|survive[grad log w_eta] for survivor-conditioned heads.
likelihood_and_gradient.numerics: Log-domain summation, no probability floor, no smoothing of fixed masks, no physical derivative through endpoints or masks.

checks.test: At each fixed probe, total branch mass1 and sum_eta w_eta*grad log w_eta=0; head normalization including END/no-speed agrees with the current law.
checks.on_failure: Stop and correct factorization/conditioning on synthetic cases; do not move to real data.

checks.test: Cached masses, event marginals and observation likelihoods equal an independently enumerated current-law reference at zero and the one fixed nonzero probe.
checks.on_failure: Stop and locate missing latent factors, feature context or prefix masks.

checks.test: Analytic NLL directional derivatives match central differences at both probes: one fixed normalized direction in each of five blocks plus one mixed direction including nonbias features. Difference probes use only the cache.
checks.on_failure: Stop and correct the analytic score/conditioning; no parameter selection.

checks.test: Existing stopped_open case agrees with P(start)=p_U*(1-p_R). Existing intent_and_survival case uses speed observation y=1 and brake-bias-only perturbation.
checks.closed_form: D(beta)=0.4+0.6*sigmoid(beta). q(1|survive)=[0.4*(1-p)*phi(3)+p*phi(1)]/D; phi is the standard normal density. At beta0, the NLL survival-gradient contribution is3/14.
checks.on_failure: Stop: the missing denominator gradient or event derivation is detectable here; do not substitute y=2, whose two speed components cancel.

checks.test: After building a cache, replace physical resolution with a failing stub during all repeated likelihood/gradient and finite-difference evaluations.
checks.on_failure: Remove hidden physical re-evaluation from cached evaluation before considering real use.

readouts: Exact agreement errors, normalization and score identities.
Analytic versus finite-difference errors and closed-form checks.
One-time synthetic enumeration counts versus zero physical calls during cache reuse, compact cache size and runtime.
decision: Only implementation consistency and reweighting feasibility. A pass does not admit a model, establish full training-domain support, or demonstrate prediction/source-transfer/control gains.
after: Stop after synthetic verification or a technical HOLD. Before any real cache construction/fitting, separately register the cohort/domain and actual storage/query/fitting budget. Current merged theta0 focal atoms cannot reconstruct latent weights or gradients.
